data_description.scan_interval: How often to read live values (10–600 s). The main station sends data every few seconds, but CO₂ changes only every 10–40 s. Below 30 s the integration uses more of Netatmo's limit of 500 calls per hour. That limit may be shared with other integrations and apps that use the same Netatmo account, so watch it if you use them.
data_description.grace_period: How long sensors keep their last value when Netatmo doesn't respond (0–60 min). 0 makes them unavailable at the first failed call.
data_description.auto_reload: Reload the integration automatically when a module is added to or removed from your station.
